item.title: Are Hot Hatches the New Supercars? - Turbo and Stance

item.title: German Chancellor Wants The EU To Reconsider The Plan To Fully Ban New Combustion Engines
item.description: In late November 2025, German Chancellor Friedrich Merz announced that Germany will formally ask the European Commission to reconsider the EU’s plan to fully ban new combustion-engine cars by 2035. Rather than a hard cut-off, Merz advocates a more technology-neutral, flexible regulation — one that would allow hybrids, highly efficient ICEs, and other alternative drivetrain...
